definitions: Having qualities of splendor or royalty.

The application of rituals or actions, especially those based on occult knowledge, to subdue or manipulate natural or supernatural beings and forces in order to have some benefit from them. .mw-parser-output .defdate{font-size:smaller}
The supernatural forces which are drawn on in such a ritual.
Having supernatural talents, properties or qualities attributed to magic.
Producing extraordinary results, as though through the use of magic.
